# Copilot Canvas: repository instructions

Read the root `AGENTS.md` first: it is the instructions for agents working on
this repository (the shape of the system, build, the verification order,
the rules that keep the product right, conventions and where to look). The
in-depth guide is `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`; skills for verification, feature
checklists, wire compatibility and UI testing are in `.claude/skills/`.
